### Bible Pathways 9/6/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-9-or-6-or-2001-722664.html
Passage: Ezekiel 21:2-27
Points:
- God revealed that His sword of judgment was sharpened and entrusted to the Babylonian conqueror.
- Nebuchadnezzar used pagan divination at the crossroads, but the Lord sovereignly guided his decision toward Jerusalem.
- King Zedekiah and the nation faced certain destruction after repeatedly ignoring prophetic warnings and persisting in rebellion.
- The earthly crown of Judah was overturned, remaining vacant until Christ, the rightful King, returns to rule.
